title: Three-dimensional adaptive ray acquisition validation: source code and synthetic results
description: Source code and original and repeated numerical result files for Adaptive Ray Acquisition in Three-Dimensional Tomography: Reconstruction Benefits and Failure Modes Under Forward-Model Mismatch. Study 1 (04P) and Study 2 (04Q-B) each contain 96 matched synthetic scenarios and 480 reconstructions. Includes five-figure generation, numerical/table audit scripts, 80 tests, original Windows provenance and SHA-256 manifest. Four shared analytic phantom families; noiseless parallel-ray simulation; no physical scanner validation. Data and provenance: CC BY 4.0. Python code and associated software documentation/configuration: MIT. Full benchmark repetition established only within the original environment; macOS preparation checks are unit tests and a small end-to-end simulation.
